Gen 7 prototype: net v2 on 7,968 deals

The v1 net and recipe retrained after adding the 3,396 boards that reached the feeds by
10:05 UTC (2,042,221 decisions against 1,003,622). On v0's 406 test deals it gives up 0.046
tricks a decision against v1's 0.057, plays Gen 6's exact card 67.9% of the time against
65.2%, and keeps 2.98 cards to probability 0.98 against 3.14. The wrong-auction test still
costs it. Released in parts as models/cardplay/gen7-policy-v2-2026-11-11.

Not yet measured for v2: its distance from a 128-layout search and its worth as the tree's
reply model.
